headline: Ghana Launches $2.45 Billion Bond Buyback Ahead of 2027 Maturity
summary: Ghana initiated a voluntary buyback offer for up to $2.45 billion of Domestic Debt Exchange Programme bonds maturing in February 2027 to enable early investor redemptions.
why: Ghana is restructuring its sovereign debt portfolio to restore public financial sustainability.

impacts.name: Ghana
impacts.why: Ghana opened an early buyback offer for $2.45 billion in domestic bonds.
